verdict.rationale: Enterprise identity and cloud-platform authentication is a fair question for an AI coding assistant sold to organizations, but the evidence pack never mentions SSO, SAML/OIDC, enterprise identity providers, or authenticating through a cloud platform. The audit logs, governance control plane and MCP allow lists it does describe are adjacent governance features, not authentication, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
